name: tour
title: Tour
description: A guided walkthrough: a spotlight on one element at a time with a card and Next, Back and Skip.
a11y: The step card is a dialog named by its title and described by its text; it takes focus on every step.
Tab stays inside the card; Escape ends the tour and focus returns to where it was.
ArrowRight and ArrowLeft move between steps when the card has focus (mirrored in right-to-left).
Each step is announced politely as "Step n of m"; the highlighted element scrolls into view.
The overlay and spotlight are hidden from assistive technology; animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the tour is showing, when controlled. Pair with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the tour starts open when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with false when the tour ends: Skip, Escape or Done.

props.name: step
props.description: The current step index when controlled. Pair with `onStepChange`.

props.name: defaultStep
props.description: The step to start on when uncontrolled. Default 0.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Called with the new index when the user moves between steps.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Called when the user finishes the last step (not when they skip or press Escape).

props.name: spotlightPadding
props.description: Extra space in px around the highlighted element. Default 6.
